hook: This open model loops its own layers three times.

beats.say: Thinking Machines released Inkling 2 Mini, an open-weights mixture of experts with twenty-six point four billion parameters, three point four billion active.
It runs its middle layers three times per token, and leads open models under one hundred billion parameters on DeepSWE, at forty-eight point two percent.
Trained mostly in NVFP4, it needs about twenty gigabytes, and ran offline on a MacBook Pro mid-flight, building a flight simulator.
